The Client  

Taigum Child Edu-care Centre in Taigum, QLD is a reputable childcare centre who provides impactful guidance for young children through their early childhood development stages.  

 

 

The Role 

The role for hire is an Early Childhood Teacher based in Taigum, QLD, it is a full-time role with an annual salary set between $83,000 to $86,000 depending on experience plus superannuation. 

 

 

The Responsibilities  

Develop and implement child-care programs that support and promote the physical, cognitive, emotional and social development of children 

Lead activities by telling or reading stories, teaching songs, taking children to local points of interest and providing opportunities to express creativity through the media of art, dramatic play, music and physical activity 

Plan and maintain an environment that protects the health, security and well-being of children 

Assess the abilities, interests and needs of children and discuss progress or problems with parents and other staff members 

Observe children for signs of potential learning or behavioural problems and prepare reports for parents, guardians or supervisor 

Guide and assist children in the development of proper eating, dressing and toilet habits 

Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with co-workers and community service providers working with children 

May plan and organize activities for school-age children in child-care programs before and after regular school hours 

May supervise and co-ordinate activities of other early childhood educators and early childhood educator assistants. 

Early childhood educator assistants perform some or all of the following duties: 

Support early childhood educators in carrying out programs that promote the physical, cognitive, emotional and social development of children 

Engage children in activities by telling stories, teaching songs and preparing crafts 

Prepare snacks and arrange rooms or furniture for lunch and rest periods 

Assist with proper eating, dressing and toilet habits 

Submit written observations on children to early childhood educators or supervisors 

Maintain daycare equipment and assist in housekeeping and cooking duties 

 

 

The Requirements 

Diploma of Early Childhood Education and Care (or equivalent) 

First Aid Qualifications and Training as prescribed by the Education and Care Services National Law Act 2010 (CPR, Asthma & Anaphylaxis, General First Aid) 

At least 12 months of professional experience in early childhood teaching in Australia 

At least 12 months’ experience teaching in early childhood education settings, delivering programs aligned with EYLF and NQS. 

At least 12 months’ experience in curriculum development, child assessment, and educational programming. 

At least 12 months’ experience mentoring and supervising educators in early childhood pedagogy and best practices. 

At least 12 months’ experience supporting children with diverse learning needs and implementing inclusive teaching strategies. 

At least 12 months’ experience liaising with parents, carers, and external agencies to support children’s learning outcomes. 

Thorough knowledge of the National Quality Framework 

A current knowledge of relevant curriculum frameworks and the ability to implement a program that caters to diversity amongst the children, educators, families and community 

A working knowledge and thorough understanding of the national quality standards, the education and care services national law act 2010 and the education and care services national regulations 2011 

Well-developed communication and inter-personal skills with children, adults, fellow educators and the community 

Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, being sensitive to the strength and weaknesses of fellow team members

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role: 
We are seeking a skilled System Administrator with strong Linux and VMware expertise to support and maintain enterprise infrastructure within a data center environment in a Managed Services team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing Linux servers, VMware virtualization platforms, system performance, security, and operational stability while ensuring high availability of critical telecom and business systems.


Key Responsibilities
•	Install, configure, administer, and maintain Linux server environments (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu, SUSE, or equivalent). 
•	Manage and support VMware vSphere, ESXi hosts, vCenter, virtual machines, and associated infrastructure components. 
•	Perform server provisioning, patch management, upgrades, and system hardening activities. 
•	Monitor infrastructure health, capacity, performance, and availability across physical and virtual environments in a telecom production environment. 
•	Troubleshoot Linux OS, VMware, storage, and networking issues impacting telecom services. 
•	Configure and maintain user accounts, permissions, authentication services, and security policies. 
•	Support backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes aligned with telecom SLAs. 
•	Implement and maintain system monitoring and automation tools used in managed services operations. 
•	Perform root cause analysis and proactively resolve infrastructure incidents within SLA timelines. 
•	Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and system configurations. 
•	Collaborate with network, storage, backup, security, and telecom operations teams. 
•	Participate in 24/7 on-call support and shift-based operations as required in managed services delivery. 
 
Required Experience
•	Minimum 3–5 years of experience as a Linux System Administrator, VMware Administrator, or Infrastructure Engineer. 
•	Strong hands-on experience in enterprise and telecom-grade environments. 
•	Proven experience managing VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, VM provisioning, clustering, and virtualization technologies. 
•	Experience with server performance tuning, monitoring, patching, and troubleshooting in production environments. 
•	Knowledge of storage technologies including SAN, NAS, and virtual storage environments. 
•	Experience supporting enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions. 
•	Familiarity with scripting and automation using Bash, Shell, Python, or Ansible. 

This role operates in a 24/7 managed services setup supporting large-scale telecom infrastructure, where stability, performance, and rapid incident resolution are critical.

Next Steps
If you would like to express interest in the role, please click on the APPLY button now. Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: From $90,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation
